verdict.rationale: Kintsugi has a per-endpoint API reference (e.g. /reference/get-filings) generated from an OpenAPI spec. Nothing in the evidence shows that reference is interactive, with a try-it console or runnable examples, so a static reference is only adjacent to this story. The MCP server's code examples and the idempotent estimate endpoint are separate features and do not count here; the spec also returned 404 at the probed public paths.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
